fields.name: PPGCaptureSHA256
fields.title: Capture SHA-256
fields.description: Exact original file-content SHA-256; distinct bytes remain distinct captures.

fields.name: PPGCaptureSourceURL
fields.title: Captured source URL
fields.description: Exact captured URL; this is provenance, not a currency or authority finding.

fields.name: PPGCaptureDate
fields.title: Captured at
fields.description: Recorded capture timestamp, stored in UTC and displayed using SharePoint regional settings; unknown stays blank. Archive dates are retained separately in source occurrences.

fields.name: PPGOriginalFilename
fields.title: Original captured filename
fields.description: Source filename before safe hosted naming; original bytes are preserved.

fields.name: PPGCaptureOrigins
fields.title: Archive source occurrences
fields.description: JSON source occurrences including archive/member, capture date and original URL. Repeated bytes retain every known occurrence.

fields.name: PPGSourceURLKey
fields.title: Source URL key
fields.description: SHA-256 of exact source URL for grouping captures at that locator. This is not policy DocumentUID or proof that different URLs represent different policies.

fields.name: PPGCaptureKind
fields.title: Capture kind
fields.description: Document or supporting source page; not a policy approval or currency classification.

fields.name: PPGCaptureEditionEvidence
fields.title: Edition linkage evidence
fields.description: Exact source-header and existing catalogue-alias evidence for recorded policy identity/edition. Does not establish current authority or approval.
